summary: CR-021 B1-B4 bug fixes verified at code level. All 4 fixes implemented correctly. Webpack compiles successfully. Login page renders correctly.
test_credentials: No login credentials available - code review + structural verification only
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-021 B1-B4 bug fixes verified. Cannot test actual split payment flow without authentication to preprod.mygenie.online.

B1_collectBillExisting_partial_payments.verification: Removed 'method === partial &&' gate. Now partial_payments array is attached whenever splitPayments.length > 0. Matches placeOrderWithPayment L1119 pattern.

B2_useEffect_clear_split_amounts.code_snippet: const prevEffectiveTotal = useRef(effectiveTotal); useEffect(() => { if (!showSplit) { prevEffectiveTotal.current = effectiveTotal; return; } if (prevEffectiveTotal.current !== effectiveTotal) { prevEffectiveTotal.current = effectiveTotal; setSplitPayments(prev => prev.map(sp => ({ ...sp, amount: '', transactionId: '' }))); } }, [effectiveTotal, showSplit]);
B2_useEffect_clear_split_amounts.verification: useEffect with prevEffectiveTotal ref clears all split amounts (amount + transactionId) when effectiveTotal changes. Dependency array [effectiveTotal, showSplit] is correct. BUG-113 contract respected (fires on bill change, not keystroke).

verification_points.border_color: Line 2714-2716: borderColor uses parseFloat(sp.amount) > 0 guard. When card amount = 0, uses COLORS.borderGray (#E5E5E5 grey/neutral). When amount > 0, shows red (#ef4444) until 4 digits entered, then green.
verification_points.background_color: Line 2717-2719: backgroundColor also uses parseFloat(sp.amount) > 0 guard. When amount = 0, uses 'white'. When amount > 0, shows light red (#fef2f2) until 4 digits, then light green.
verification_points.hint_text: Line 2723-2725: '4 digits' hint only shows when parseFloat(sp.amount) > 0 AND transactionId.length > 0 AND transactionId.length < 4.

verification_points.B3_card_txn_id_guard: Line 3082: splitPayments.some(sp => sp.method === 'card' && parseFloat(sp.amount) > 0 && (!sp.transactionId || sp.transactionId.length !== 4)) - Pay button NOT disabled due to empty Card Txn ID when card split amount = 0 or empty (parseFloat(sp.amount) > 0 guard).
verification_points.B4_sum_check: Line 3083: splitPayments.reduce((s, p) => s + (parseFloat(p.amount) || 0), 0) < effectiveTotal - Pay button disabled when sum of split amounts < effectiveTotal. Enabled when sum >= effectiveTotal.

regression_BUG113_free_typing.verification: Split amount inputs allow free typing without real-time clamping. Clamp only happens on blur (onBlur handler at line 2665-2688). BUG-113 contract preserved.

regression_BUG241_card_txn_id.verification: Card Txn ID input still present for card split rows. 4-digit validation still enforced when card amount > 0 (line 3082).

webpack_compilation.notes: Webpack compiled successfully with only eslint warnings (React hooks dependencies in report pages). No errors. Frontend loads correctly.

login_page_rendering.notes: Login page loads correctly with MyGenie logo, tagline, email/password inputs, LOG IN button, Remember me checkbox, Forgot Password link.
